query_text: Create a ranked horizontal bar chart showing the bottom 8 countries by support-to-clinical ratio in the 2021 report, where support-to-clinical ratio is `(grants_support_initiatives + life_business_adaptation) / (diagnostics + treatment)`, values are expressed as a ratio, countries must have `(diagnostics + treatment) > 0` and at least 8 total sampled innovations, and bars are sorted from the lowest ratio to the highest after the ratio is derived.
